name: OneDrive / SharePoint
description: Bounded Microsoft Graph file, folder, version, permission, site and list operations with externally supplied OAuth access tokens.

permissions.description: Microsoft Graph global v1.0 over HTTPS with a selected connection access token; bounded file downloads may follow one Microsoft preauthenticated HTTPS location without Authorization. No filesystem, ambient credentials or OAuth refresh. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.documentation:
Get Drive Root. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Get Drive Item. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. List Item Versions. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. Get Item Version. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
List Item Permissions. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Update or Move Item. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Restore Item Version. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Delete Item Permission. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. Create Sharing Link. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Replace File Content. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Create File Content. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Download File Content. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Get Site. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Create List Item. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.documentation:
Update List Item Fields. Microsoft Graph v1.0 only. Select an OAuth connection with credentials.accessToken; token acquisition and renewal are external. One bounded page, 1 MiB JSON, 512 KiB content, total deadline including profile loading, no retries. Mutations require confirm=true; never replay uncertain writes. definitions.name: OneDrive SharePoint item.changed Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by OneDrive SharePoint item.changed.
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for OneDrive SharePoint item.changed. Canonical relay contract onf.business.v1 is documented in the package ingress setup. The relay must verify the original provider, persist/normalize the event and then authenticate its HTTPS POST with a separate ONF header token. The decoder never sees provider headers and does not verify provider signatures. Only selected resource fields are emitted. Filters scopeId/resourceId are exact matches. Deduplication keeps the last 64 scoped event IDs and checkpoints on trigger success before downstream completion. Repeated older deliveries can run again; downstream operations must be idempotent. No subscription, relay or secret is provisioned by installation. Provider setup: Implement Graph POST ?validationToken=… verification at the relay: return the URL-decoded token as text/plain with HTTP 200 within ten seconds; this is not ONF GET challenge support. For basic notifications, compare clientState in constant time with the saved subscription secret and allowlist tenantId, subscriptionId and subscribed resource. Reject rich notifications (validationTokens/encryptedContent); this contract uses includeResourceData=false only. Create the least-privileged subscription manually, maintain its expiration and lifecycle notifications, and keep the OAuth grant current. Split value[] into separate canonical events; redact clientState. Use notification id when supplied, or persist a stable relay identity per admitted notification across its ONF retries. The relay may assign different IDs to separate duplicate provider deliveries; exact provider deduplication is not promised. Drive/list notifications are change hints, not individual file/row records. Maintain a durable Graph delta cursor at the relay, follow every nextLink and checkpoint deltaLink only after admitted events are queued. Handle expired delta tokens by explicit baseline recovery. Map actual delta items to item.changed/item.deleted; scopeId is driveId or site/list identity, resourceId is item.id. Use the durable delta position and item version as eventId; do not treat each root hint as a file modification.

ingressRequirements.name: OneDrive SharePoint verified event relay
ingressRequirements.description: Graph drive/list change relay. Accepts the canonical onf.business.v1 envelope only; an external provider-aware relay is required.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.
Implement Graph POST ?validationToken=… verification at the relay: return the URL-decoded token as text/plain with HTTP 200 within ten seconds; this is not ONF GET challenge support.

For basic notifications, compare clientState in constant time with the saved subscription secret and allowlist tenantId, subscriptionId and subscribed resource. Reject rich notifications (validationTokens/encryptedContent); this contract uses includeResourceData=false only.

Create the least-privileged subscription manually, maintain its expiration and lifecycle notifications, and keep the OAuth grant current. Split value[] into separate canonical events; redact clientState.

Use notification id when supplied, or persist a stable relay identity per admitted notification across its ONF retries. The relay may assign different IDs to separate duplicate provider deliveries; exact provider deduplication is not promised.

Drive/list notifications are change hints, not individual file/row records. Maintain a durable Graph delta cursor at the relay, follow every nextLink and checkpoint deltaLink only after admitted events are queued. Handle expired delta tokens by explicit baseline recovery.

Map actual delta items to item.changed/item.deleted; scopeId is driveId or site/list identity, resourceId is item.id. Use the durable delta position and item version as eventId; do not treat each root hint as a file modification.

Emit canonical JSON {contract:"onf.business.v1",provider:"onedrive-sharepoint",eventType,eventId,scopeId,resourceId,occurredAt,resource}; occurredAt and nullable resource fields must explicitly be null when unavailable. The resource fields and eventType are defined by the selected trigger schema. Preserve eventId across relay retries.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-provider-relay"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
